# Fix Group 2: SearchDialog.tsx: SC 1.1.1, SC 2.1.1, SC 4.1.2 +2 more
 
## Findings
 
10 compliance findings in `packages/app-store/giphy/components/SearchDialog.tsx`.
 
## Remediation
 
- **sonde/i18n.hardcoded-string (Hard-coded user-facing string):** Hard-coded user-facing string: "Not the perfect GIF?" (jsx-text)
  - Fix: Wrap the string with the project's active i18n framework (`msg()`, `<Trans>`, `t!`, etc.).
- **sonde/i18n.hardcoded-string (Hard-coded user-facing string):** Hard-coded user-facing string: "Shuffle" (jsx-text)
  - Fix: Wrap the string with the project's active i18n framework (`msg()`, `<Trans>`, `t!`, etc.).
- **wcag-2.1.1-keyboard (Keyboard):** <div> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
  - Fix: Add onKeyDown or onKeyUp handler that provides equivalent keyboard interaction.
- **wcag-1.1.1-icon-label (Non-text Content):** Interactive <Input> has no accessible name (no text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby).
  - Fix: Add visible text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby to provide an accessible name.
- **wcag-2.1.1-keyboard (Keyboard):** <DialogClose> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
  - Fix: Add onKeyDown or onKeyUp handler that provides equivalent keyboard interaction.
- **wcag-4.1.2-name-role-value (Name, Role, Value):** <DialogClose> is interactive (has event handlers) but has no ARIA role. Assistive technology cannot determine its purpose.
  - Fix: Add an appropriate role attribute (e.g., role="button", role="link", role="tab").
- **sonde/wcag/compliance (wcag):** <DialogClose> is interactive (has event handlers) but has no ARIA role. Assistive technology cannot determine its purpose.
  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy
- **sonde/wcag/compliance (wcag):** Interactive <Input> has no accessible name (no text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby).
  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy
- **sonde/wcag/compliance (wcag):** <div> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy
- **sonde/wcag/compliance (wcag):** <DialogClose> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
  - Fix: Apply structured probe fix strategy

# Fix Group 2: NoAvailabilityDialog.tsx: SC 2.1.1, SC 4.1.2, wcag
 
## Findings
 
4 compliance findings in `packages/features/calendars/components/NoAvailabilityDialog.tsx`.
 
## Remediation
 
- **wcag-2.1.1-keyboard (Keyboard):** <DialogClose> has a mouse handler but no keyboard handler. Keyboard users cannot interact with it.
